title: Add a question from your phone

steps.text: On your phone, open Quick update.
Do you work with furniture I already own?
steps.caption: Ask it the way a client would.

steps.text: Always. We start with what you love and build around it.
steps.caption: Answer it simply.
Not sure of the group? Leave it, and move it later.
Tap the button. It goes at the end of its group.
